column1: # Alex waits in the Altin Peak west exit after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: Isaac. You walk many roads\nfor a man who hates\nwhere they all lead.{end_wait}
Alex? Where were you when\nVale drowned? What do\nyou want from me?{end_wait}
Not every friend you keep\nis a friend. Count your\nparty twice, Isaac.{end_wait}
The rain will tell you\nthe rest. It always\ndoes, in the end.{end_wait}
